data.one_liner: Animates a line‑through effect over Text, RichText, TextField or TextFormField.
data.what_it_does: Provides AnimatedLineThrough and AnimatedLineThroughRaw widgets that draw and animate a strike‑through line on supported text widgets. Supports RTL, custom stroke width and full control via an Animation object.
use_when: You need a simple animated strike‑through on text without writing custom painters
You want RTL support and control over animation duration or progress
avoid_when: You need complex text decorations beyond a line through
You require a full‑featured animation library for many widget types
strengths: Very lightweight and focused on one effect
Works with both static and editable text widgets
weaknesses: Only handles line‑through, no other decorations
Limited to widgets using RenderParagraph or RenderEditable
No built‑in theming beyond color and width

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: General‑purpose animation library that can animate any widget, including custom painters for line‑through effects
